```cypher
MATCH (m:Maintainer)-[:MAINTAINS]->(p:Plugin)
WHERE m.display_name = 'Gareth Barnard'
AND (p.last_release_ts IS NULL OR p.last_release_ts < (datetime({year: 2026, month: 9, day: 10}).epochSeconds - (3 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60)))
RETURN p.component, p.name, p.last_release_ts
ORDER BY p.name
LIMIT 100
```
